simple.meaning: בֶּטֶן (beṭen) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “the belly , especially the womb ; also the bosom or body of anything.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 72 times across Genesis, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Judges, 1 Kings, and 12 more, beginning at Genesis 25:23. Its contexts include priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בֶּטֶן (H990).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: בֶּטֶן (beṭen) / H990 is traced through Genesis 25:23, Genesis 25:24, Genesis 30:2, Genesis 38:27 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: the belly , especially the womb ; also the bosom or body of anything
definitions.usage: belly, body, as they be born, within, womb.
definitions.full: H990. beten I. בֶ֫טֶן noun feminine Num 5:25 belly, body, womb (Arabic ) — ׳בּ absolute Judg 13:7 +; בָּ֑טֶן 13:5 +; construct בֶּטֶן Psa 139:13 +; suffix בִּטְנִי Job 3:10 +; בִּטְנְךָ Deut 7:13 +; בִּטְנֵךְ Gen 25:23 ; בִּטְנוֺ Job 15:2 +, etc.; — 1. a. belly, abdomen , of man Judg 3:21-22 , of woman Num 5:21-22 , 27 ; as beautiful in form Cant 7:3; as seat of hunger Prov 13:25 ; as eating Ezek 3:3 (|| מֵעִים ); compare Prov 18:20 (figurative); as seat of passion, avarice, etc. Job 20:20 , 23 ; in figure of God's casting riches out of extortioner's belly 20:15 (|| וַיְקִאֶנּוּ ), compare also Psa 17:14 ; figurative of innermost part of man = inmost soul Prov 18:8 = 26:22 ; 20:27 , 30 (all ב ׳חַדְרֵי ); as seat of intell. faculties (= English breast or bosom ) 22:18 (compare מֵעִים Psa 40:9 ) Job 15:2 ; 15:35 ; 32:18 , בִּטְנִי רוּחַ 15:19 ; as trembling at theophany Hab 3:16 . b. belly of hippopotamus Job 40:16 . c. שְׁאוֺל בֶּטֶן Jonah 2:3 (Jonah's prayer: || יַמִּים בִּלְבַכ מְצוּלָה ). 2 body , opposed to soul Psa 31:10 (opposed to נֶפֶשׁ ), also 44:26 (opposed to id. ; — on this compare Zim Bp 71 ). 3 womb Gen 25:23-24 , 38:27 (all J) Hosea 12:4 ; Job 10:19 (|| רֶחֶם 10:18 ) Eccl 11:5 ; Job 31:15 עָשָׂ֑הוּ עשֵֹׁנִי בַבֶּטֶן הֲלֹא did not he that made me in the womb make him (|| אֶחָד בָּרֶחֶם וַיְכֻנֶנּוּ ); compare Psa 139:13 בְּבֶטֶן תְּסֻכֵּנִי , & Jer 1:5 ; especially ב ׳מְּרִי i.e. offspring Gen 30:2 (E) Psa 127:3 ; Isa 13:18 ; Prov 31:2 בִּטְנִי בַּר = my son (|| בְּרִי ) compare בֶּןבִּֿטְנָהּ Isa 49:15 ; of birth מִבֶּטֶן יָצָא Job 1:21 ; 3:11 ; Eccl 5:14 ; בֶּטֶן alone = birth Hosea 9:11 (|| הֵרָיוֺן לֵדָה, ), compare Figurative הַקָּ֑רַח יָצָא מִי מִבֶּטֶן Job 38:29 out of whose womb came the ice ? compare בִּטְנִי דַּלְתֵי סָגַר לֹא 3:10 i.e. of my (mother's) womb ; מִבֶּטֶן גָּחָה take, draw out of the womb , subject ׳י (i.e. cause to be born) Psa 22:10 ; בֶטֶן מְּרִי used also of father Micah 6:7 , compare Psa 132:11 (David as ancestor of Messianic King); Job 19:17 בִטְנִי בְּנֵי sons of my body , of doubtful interpretation, perhaps = sons of my (mother's) womb , compare 3:10 (Ges De), i.e. my brother or men of my clan RS K 33 f. , others my sons (Ew), my grandsons (Di); also in addressing Israel As a whole (masculine suffix) Deut 7:13 ; 28:4 , 11 , 18 , 53 ; 30:9 , compare בִטְנָם מַחֲמַדֵּי Hosea 9:16 beloved ones of their womb ; מִןהַֿבֶּטֶן (מִבֶּטֶן) = from birth Judg 13:5 , 7 ; Psa 58:4 ; 71:6 , compare also Isa 44:2 , 24 ; 46:3 (|| רָחַ֑ם ) 48:8 ; 49:1 , 5 ; נִמִּי מִבֶּטֶן id. Judg 16:17 ; Job 31:18 ; Psa 22:11 (|| רֶחֶם ). 4 architectural word of some rounded projection connected with the two pillars Jachin & Boaz 1Kin 7:20 (Klo reads הבית ).
